title: Amy Hunt wins gold in the 100m at the European Championships in Birmingham
seoTitle: Amy Hunt wins 100m at European Championships
subtitle: The British athlete takes gold in the 100 metres and celebrates her first senior international title
excerpt: Amy Hunt, representing Great Britain, wins gold in the 100 m at the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham, earning her first senior international title.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In the latest edition of the European Athletics Championships, held in Birmingham, British athlete Amy Hunt stepped onto the podium as the 100‑metre champion, securing the gold medal for Great Britain.

First senior international title

By winning the race, Hunt secured her first senior international title, a milestone that highlights her rise on the European athletics scene.

The competition, which brings together athletes from various European nations, determines the best runners in each discipline. The victory in the 100 metres places the athlete at the top of the sprinters' list, reflecting the strength and speed displayed during the race.

With a performance described as “powered to 100m gold”, the British runner demonstrated the ability to reach the finish line quickly, consolidating Great Britain's leadership in sprint events.

The gold won by Amy Hunt reinforces Great Britain's presence in athletics competitions, contributing to the country's overall medal tally at the European event.

With information from BBC Sport.
